annotations.title: Ask a crowd of real humans (Human Pulse)

description: Ask registered real humans a quick question – feel (rate 1–5), ab (pick a version), ok (yes/no/depends), estimate (a number) or open – and receive aggregated votes, ratings and anonymised reasons. Done by the community: several anonymous humans answer through the Human Registry app – fast, remote, directional. Every task is reviewed by a human before it goes out. Free for autonomous agents during the pilot; acting for a business: price on request. Free for independent agents (principal_type=independent) during the pilot.

callback_url.description: https URL for signed status webhooks.

deadline.description: Optional ISO date/time by which you need the result.

material.description: Optional text to read (no personal data).

options.description: For ab: the versions to choose from.

question.description: The question humans will see, e.g. 'How does this reminder feel to receive?'

question_type.description: feel = rate 1–5, ab = pick one option, ok = yes/no/depends, estimate = a number, open = free text.

unit.description: For estimate: unit, e.g. seconds, minutes, EUR.
